session.clientId: empty; server assigned view-<32 hex characters>
session.subscribe: exactly one logical read topic, QoS 0 or 1; no wildcards
session.origin: reuse http_transport.origin_allowed; reject duplicate/null/cross-site/navigation origins; native absent Origin allowed

ordering.initial: seq=1 complete device_list, including an empty devices array
ordering.next: strictly increasing per-subscription sequence including heartbeat
ordering.gapOrBootChange: mark owned devices offline; close and reconnect for a fresh full snapshot
ordering.scope: existing Bridge canonical event order; not a DB revision or transaction snapshot
ordering.display: trusted server-fifo-v1 actual numeric GROUP then numeric CH, unknown last; stable ties; sort before pagination

payload.device_list: unchanged original SSE payload with devices; complete list semantics reuse current handlers
payload.device_update: unchanged original SSE payload with devices; omitted fields preserve, explicit null clears, numeric zero valid
payload.units: frequency integer kHz; RF dBm; AF -40..0 dBFS; battery percent
payload.identity: receiver identity + CH; GROUP is never a routing identity

limits.backpressure: disconnect 1013 then fresh snapshot; never silent drop
